main_measure.name: |forecast|-weighted mean of next-bar return minus coin mean, short bars
main_measure.threshold: t <= -2 with negative mean confirms; t >= +2 with positive mean rejects

supporting_check.name: down-bar share on active vs all bars (binomial z)

decided_by: Inconclusive: t lies strictly between -2 and +2.
reading: Coin mean taken over all tested bars of all windows; t of the weighted mean uses the weighted variance with Kish effective n; a down-cross stretch is a run of bars with negative raw SMA spread containing an active bar; the supporting check passes when z >= 2.
